Maria (security): Quick sync 1 - we're scheduling a base-image rebuild for staging on Thu 09:00 PT. Need to preflight RBAC tweaks, audit export, and a KMS signing key rotation plan.
Jordan (eng-infra): Understood. Is this a full reprovision of rootfs or a compact rebase?
Maria (security): Full refresh of runtime-base:1.4 -> runtime-base:1.5. We'll drop some unused packages and upgrade glibc/openssl.
Lee (runtime): Heads-up: canary rollout will require cordoning a few nodepools. Any expected service-account changes?
Maria (security): Minimize SA churn. New part: we'll create a dedicated KMS key for staging signing: `projects/redwood/kms/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/staging-rotate`.
Anita (SRE): We also need to ensure KMS Sign audit events are captured as DATA_ACCESS and forwarded to Splunk. Can infra add a logsink filter?
Jordan (eng-infra): Yes. I'll add a sink filtering on `protoPayload.methodName:"cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign"` to the splunk index and test.
devops-bot: Tip: run `./scripts/image-preflight.sh staging` and `./scripts/check-audit-sinks.sh` before the window :robot_face:
Maria (security): IAM question: current builder SA has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. For cosign with KMS do we need `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier`?
Lee (runtime): From previous runs cosign needs Sign capability. Granting `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` is typical. Also if you impersonate a SA, ensure `iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` or `iam.serviceAccountUser` on the actor.
Jordan (eng-infra): I'll provision a temporary grant: add `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` to builder-staging@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com and `iam.serviceAccountUser` for the orchestrator. We remove permissions after the rollout.
Maria (security): Runtime fallback: allow images signed by previous key for 2 hours post-cutover. We want dual-key validation during the window.
Lee (runtime): I'll introduce dual-key acceptance behind a feature flag. Runtime will check both public keys/thumbprints.
Maria (security): Quick RBAC snippet I'll put in the PR:
```yaml
- members:
  - serviceAccount:builder-staging@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
```
Jordan (eng-infra): Looks good. I'll open the terraform PR and include a short lifecycle policy for scheduled removal.
Anita (SRE): Failure scenarios: if signing breaks mid-rollout -> (1) pause the rollout, (2) runtime should accept the old key, (3) create incident with tag `image-rebuild` and notify sec-oncall.
sec-oncall: Acknowledged. If a CVE is discovered during rebuild, mark severity P0/P1 and tag `image-rebuild` for tracking.
Maria (security): Action items: Jordan - create KMS key + IAM PR by EOD; Lee - add dual-key validation + canary; Anita - confirm audit sink and alerting; Maria - document RBAC revoke steps post-cutover.
Jordan (eng-infra): I'll push the terraform diff within 3 hours and add notes on short-lived grants.
Lee (runtime): Will push a tiny canary change to runtime with the feature flag and ping this thread when live.
Maria (security): Thanks. If anyone can't make the Thu window DM me. Otherwise we'll run the preflights Wed evening and proceed. :thumbsup:
